description: pip is deliberately NOT enabled. The only Python dependency surface is
requirements-ci-test.txt, a byte-identical vendored copy of dotfiles' ci-test
rendering whose source of truth is dotfiles' uv.lock. Bumping a pin here would edit
a generated artifact, break the diff-based staleness check, and be overwritten by the
next sync -- so the update would be silently discarded. Upgrades belong upstream.
Note the current filename does not match Renovate's pip_requirements pattern anyway
(it allows one [-._]\w+ segment after 'requirements', and '-ci-test' is two), but that
is luck rather than design: renaming this to requirements-test.txt would pull it into
scope with no signal. This exclusion is the deliberate part.
pinDigests is on per ADR-0006 (pin GitHub Actions to immutable SHA digests).
Measured at enablement: 15 unique action refs, 1 already SHA-pinned, 14 not --
including dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable, a BRANCH ref that moves with no release
and no signal. Expect a one-time burst of ~14 pin PRs converging the existing refs;
pinDigests converges what is already there, it does not merely prevent new drift.
extends is config:recommended with the shared preset INLINED, not
github>brujack/ai-config//renovate-presets/default.json. ai-config is private and this
repo is public; Renovate resolves extends at initRepo BEFORE dependency extraction, so
an unfetchable preset throws config-validation and abandons the whole repository.
Measured: zero Renovate PRs on this repo, all time, since 2026-05-24 -- and the fleet
split is exact, the three private repos got PRs and the three public ones got none.
The duplication is deliberate: a live inlined policy beats a centralised dead one.
Keep in sync with ai-config/renovate-presets/default.json by hand.
